correctness.rationale: Two radius-2 downward-error descendant balls intersect iff max(|x\y|,|y\x|)≤2; verified independently for all 32640 unordered pairs among 256 binary words by building actual downward balls. Full increasing-vertex compatibility clique DFS reimplemented from the metric with safe bound pruning visits 16853807 nodes, exhausts all size-seven cliques, finds 181440 labeled optima and none of size eight, matching digest 154a2b608261b4e4686ea9e83954a42852b7d82b6db2d27c7e5db7972b40bcff of sorted decimal code tuples. Orbit closure under generating adjacent coordinate swaps yields sizes (20160,40320×4); adding global complement yields (20160,80640,80640), exhausting 181440. This is a finite exact classification at n=8 and error radius two only; classical optimum seven itself is not new.
